notes.title: Devlog update
notes.content:
Returned with some updates, I am pretty excited to share you some stuff that has happened in past months.
A lot has happened in my private life that had me to step back from the development, take a break, refresh a bit and find a new approach to the game. In order to achieve the completion of the game, I had to focus on the things that would make this both a game that I can deliver and also a game I can say, it is fun, it is worth your time and money. During all this time I played games that inspire me, focusing on what feels good and trying to understand why. Also read and watched a lot of content related to game design, feeling way more confident that I can deliver something fun.

Game development means two things, coding and implementing the game (which includes art, music etc) and game design. Well, while I am super confident in my skills as a developer, same with art and music, I was not as confident in my skills as a game designer, after all I am doing this by myself, out of love of the craft of building game. Putting together a game is hard, but it is doable, you throw some art, some music, some sounds and some coding and you get a game, but it is not enough to get a fun experience, having learned that the hard way across all these years in the past, I realized I need to rethink my plan.

After diligently researching and learning about game design, made a new plan. This next months I will focus on adding all the skills that the crab will have.
Here is a list of the skills that you will be able to unlock as you play through the world:
[list]
[*]Strong claws (this is the skill that makes you able to attack enemies, more of a lore entry)
[*]Strong legs (this is also a lore entry, making the crab jump the "normal" amount of units)
[*]Water affinity (enabling the player to move with the same speed under water as on land)
[*]Dashing (this ability will enable you to move way faster and also jump further and across bigger gaps)
[*]Fire claws (this will enable you to have a short ranged attack that you can discharge on a group of enemies)
[*]Strong pinchers (this will enable you to grab on the wall and walk on the ceiling)
[*]Strong arms (this will enable you to grab objects and enemies and throw them)
[*]Long arms (this is a funky one, but cannot drop it as an idea, it is exactly how it sounds)
[/list]

[url=https://trello.com/c/PwA2DWIN/122-crabby-design-implement]You can follow the development in here[/url]

With these set in place I can then design the maps easier, but right now my focus is in making a fun crab to play with, and I start to have way and way more fun with it.
I will return with updates, for now, below are some previews on what was made, remember a lot of planning was done to get this closer to completion. Please let me know what you think in the comments below.
